rows.behavior_contract: Recipient search enforces destination eligibility before exposure through one source-neutral authorization function shared by native SearchRecipients and the shipping Host picker. Message/media/poll policy, community/channel state, protected-source denial and standard/secret compatibility are checked before exposure; send-other/inline/game are typed requirements and fail closed while their permission axes are not yet represented by the canonical Conversation owner.
rows.state_machine: authenticated recipient query + actual source message identity -> source requirement derivation -> canonical visibility/policy facts -> recipient_search_authorized -> index/expose eligible candidates only
